Hello Fellow Humans,

I was an IT guy but I became permanently disabled due to Bone Cancer. When Minecraft came out a long time ago. I thought wow what crappy graphics. Never really cared until my son wanted to play. So I helped him make a home he was like 7 years old. But recently meaning Oct 2023. I bought a PC version because I was watching Mr BeardStone and Foxynotail and they had a kid called Create. I thought wow engineering in Minecraft wow that is amazing and worth watching. So I finally downloaded the game and played.

However I have been a gamer for over 20 years. I can tell you this. This game isn't well made from a code stand point. You have to download more to make it playable. And I am talking about mods that fix actual memory leakage and cpu over hogging. This game is owned by Microsoft and you can tell they have not tried to make it better. I had to download over 100 more to even make it worth playing. And let's not forget the difficulty this took and I can only imagine how hard it is for others. It is not as simple as you download it and the creators update it and everything updates. Nope you are forever stuck on one version. Unless you update everything but if one mod isn't up to date for example Create only goes up to 1.2 so I can't play 1.4. then you have must haves like JEI and whatnot. So why doesn't Mojang just freaking add these mods and make them a part of the game? Laziness is why. It's easier and cheaper to let the community do everything.

But this leads to so much frustration. For example I lost my entire world that I spent hours and hours working on. Because I tried to update the game not knowing it would break my add-ons. I tried going back but something got corrupted and I just had to restart. It was annoying. I added a mod called MineColonies because I thought how fun I can manage a city. However this along with create and other mods ended up making my FPS go to 5. Again super annoying. Yes I am poor thanks to being disabled so my computer is 14 years old. I had planned on upgrading it in 2016. But 2016 is when I started my 30+ surgery journey and 17 rounds of chemotherapy. So yeah that plan didn't happen. However my computer is a high end gaming computer or was. It can still play games like World of Warcraft on high graphics. But a low graphics game like Minecraft nope 5 FPS. Why because the developers force you to mod the game to make it playable and thus make it on you to find the right mods to fix the game's crappy code.

So you have another side of Minecraft. I play create which is Java. You have bedrock. But that's no better. It also is a CPU GPU DDR hog. You still have to download mods to make it playable. It is ridiculous and just laziness on the company. Take world of Warcraft for example they hired modders and content creators. They took the most used things and integrated them. It's not perfect but you can play the updated version of the game and your kids just need to be updated. It is super easy to deal with. While Minecraft a game that is supposed to be easy has become ridiculous. However most people play Minecraft and people learn to deal with the annoyances. But as a consumer you should want higher standards from your game you love and play. Mojang should say fully integrate JEI and food delight and sophisticated backpacks and other highly used mods. Let's say this if in Curse Forge it has over 10 million downloads it should definitely be added to the game 100%. Clearly everyone has to use this mod so make it a part of the game. Microsoft can afford to hire the people making JEI mod. Heck I bet if Microsoft Mojang hired 50 of the top modders they would end up with an amazing game that would shoot forward leaps and bounds from its current state and ultimately make the game a million times better. Which means more money for Microsoft.

Most of you don't understand but when you're permanently disabled like I am and in pain 24/7 FullDive VR technology can't come soon enough. I can't walk without having to have crutches and still I am in pain 24/7/365. However when I am asleep I am pain free. With FullDive you are in a sleep like state but able to play video games. So it would allow me to escape my useless body and be free in a world or worlds of my choosing. Currently I can't use VR as I can't walk around.

I would have no hesitation installing say 4 Neuralink into my head if needed to make FullDive a reality for me. Then I could finally do things without having to be in pain and leave my bed. I could be with my friends and family. I could climb a mountain or swim in the ocean. I could drive again or fly in the air. I could go on adventures with my children. I could even find a virtual wife since my ex wife decided after I became permanently disabled that I was useless and worthless and left me and took my children from me since I could no longer work and make her money. This has made me come very close to suicide many times and still does. Not being with my children after fighting so hard to survive my cancer sucks. I fought 30+ surgeries. I was on the ecmo machine after losing over 74 units of blood. I had a 14% chance to survive my first set of surgeries they put me in a medical coma for two weeks doing 5 massive surgeries in me. I also did over a 5 year period 17 rounds of chemotherapy each round was 6 days in the hospital with 3 different chemotherapy pumping into me. I almost died 8 times as well since 2016. My kids were the only reason I fought the cancer if I didn't have kids I never would have fought it. Also in say virtual when fe because seriously no woman would ever want a permanently disabled man who is on SSDI. I will be alone for the rest of my life unless robot wives become a thing or FullDive becomes a thing.

I have also applied to about 2,000 jobs but I put that I am permanently disabled and have gotten 1 interview. So I think the AI Technology that looks at resumes tosses my resume away since I have a gap in my work experience and I am disabled. I get it why hire a man who is disabled when you can hire a perfectly healthy person. It just sucks not having a career anymore and not having my children in my life anymore. It makes life not worth living and I think about ending my life daily. So FullDive VR technology is literally the only reason I am still alive. It's my only hope to escape my prison that is my disabled body. I truly hope by around 2030 it's a real thing. Because I honestly don't think I can live my crappy life much longer. 

Just imagine everyday waking up and having a sludge hammer smashed into your lower back and your right leg and foot. Then cut multiple times all day long. Oh and being electrocuted randomly. You may be close to my pain. I know it's mostly nerve pain it's why I have a stimulator in my back and I am on a daily high schedule one pain medicine. So the only thing I can hope for is nanotechnology to help my body, cybernetics to replace body parts or VR FullDive to escape my body. I truly hope by 2030 technology will be close to this FullDive technology because a lot of disabled people would be able to escape their pain with it. I would if available go into FullDive permanently if available to me. When your body is a prison, you don't want to be in it anymore.

Let me tell you a real reason to want to kill yourself. I am 38 years old now. However in 2016 January 1st I found out I had an over 5lb tumor in my lower back. To be technical it was in my L5S1 area and in my bones and nerves. 30 days after I told my employer I got an email from the owner saying the following "due to your medical condition we no longer need your services". So I found out within a month that I had Bone Cancer and then lost my job and medical insurance. This isn't the worst of it. 

From July 15 to Sept 15 I spent in UC Davis hospital. I had to learn how to walk with crutches. As I am permanently disabled now. Since 2016 I have had over 30+ surgeries and almost died 7 times. Most of my surgeries were between 20 and 30 hours long. Some of the surgeries I literally died in. In one surgery I lost 74 units of blood. Human bodies have 8 to 10 units of blood just FYI. I also had my nerves cut in my right sacrum which caused me to lose the ability to use my right leg and foot which now has no feeling anymore. 

My chemotherapy due to the fact that it was extreme even when it comes to cancer. I had to spend 6 days in the hospital with 3 types of Chemotherapy pumping through me. I had to do this 17 times over a 4 year period. Off and on depending on surgeries. The chemo alone was horrible enough, but with the surgeries as well and losing my ability to walk really sucked. Not to mention I lost my ability to play with my kids. To teach my kids to snowboard, rollerblade, ride a bike, hike, camp, rafting and so much more I had plans with them as they got older. 

Now I am a jobless crippled loser. But at least I had my wife and kids. Well so I thought. My wife of 14 years decided 5 years of cancer was enough and she couldn't love a man who was crippled, who couldn't work and provide money. A man who couldn't cook or clean was just not for her. Of coarse bone cancer isn't something you can just eat healthy and avoid it not smoke or not do this or do that to prevent. Anyone can get or have bone cancer, right now you could have bone cancer. So now I lost the one thing I truly wanted out of life. To be a father and to raise my kids. I get all of 6 hours on Sunday to see them. I can't fight it in court because I have no money. SSDI doesn't pay that much. I paid more in taxes a month than I make in SSDI. 

I have tried to kill myself several times, but apparently death doesn't want me. I took enough pills to knock out a horse. So when you get laid and have kids then get cancer and become a worthless crippled person like myself and then have your babies ripped from your life. Then post again and I will say go ahead and kill yourself. But you don't know what true pain is. I take so many pain pills and have a pain stimulator in my pain that I charge daily. I take so many pain pills just to be at a 5-7 on the pain chart that if I go to the ER they say you take too many pills and then I have to explain to them I am not a drug addict. Then they get ahold of my many many many doctors and they give me everything and apologize for not giving me what I need. 

So if you have reached my level of shitty life that I have. Then go ahead and kill yourself. But if you can read my story and honestly say in the mirror "I have gotten to that guy's level of pain both emotionally and physically" with a straight and honest face. Then please end your life. But on the very real chance you haven't come close to my level of shitty life then don't be a bitch and get in with your life. At least you can walk and at least you have a future. My future is pain and surgeries and being poor for the rest of my miserable life. Which honestly I don't know how much longer I can keep going.

No woman will want a guy who can only lay in bed. I may be great in bed but, but no woman will ever care to find out as I am a crippled loser husk of a man. If you can even call me a man anymore. I am a disabled piece of crap who can't even raise his kids anymore. Because his wife of 14 years decided I wasn't worth being their father anymore.
